title.zh: Crypto, Banks Take Clarity Act Lobbying Fight to Senators' Home States
title.en: Crypto, Banks Take Clarity Act Lobbying Fight to Senators' Home States

current_state.zh: Crypto advocates and community bankers are intensifying lobbying efforts in senators' home states ahead of the Senate's September 15 procedural vote on the Clarity Act, which would establish federal digital asset rules and split oversight between the SEC and CFTC.
current_state.en: Crypto advocates and community bankers are intensifying lobbying efforts in senators' home states ahead of the Senate's September 15 procedural vote on the Clarity Act, which would establish federal digital asset rules and split oversight between the SEC and CFTC.
